source_contract: BatchPutFromLayers constructs raw-address buffer arrays and calls native BatchPut.
BatchPut calls PutData2Blobs, which gathers/WaitFeatures copy futures; then SyncUpdateState publishes per-key write result.
This rejects treating the FIFO event as the only cache metadata publication fence in source. It does not prove producer device writes preceded raw copy, or runtime SDK multi-buffer correctness.
runtime_scope: No SDK/package/config installation or model change; pinned public git source audited on Mac. Source-pre-PUT fence test remains single variable.
